subject: gk
question: Which of the following has universal acceptability in discharge of debt & payment obligations?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Legal tender money**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Legal tender money** is money that must be accepted if offered in payment of a debt.
 
• It is recognized by the **law of the land** as a valid form of payment.
 
• In most countries, the central bank or government issues **legal tender money**.
 
• Examples include **coins and banknotes** issued by a central authority.
 
• **Legal tender money** is backed by the government and is universally accepted within the country.
 
• It is essential for **economic stability and functioning** of the financial system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bonds**__

 __
 
• **Bonds** are debt securities issued by entities such as governments, municipalities, and corporations.
 
• They represent a loan made by an investor to the issuer.
 
• Bonds pay periodic interest and return the principal at maturity.
 
• They are not universally accepted for payment of debts and obligations.
 
 
 
• **Houses**__
 __
 
• **Houses** are tangible assets and real estate properties.
 
• They can be used as collateral for loans but are not a form of money.
 
• Houses are not accepted for settling debts in a direct transaction.
 
 
 
• **Landed property**__
 
 
• **Landed property** refers to land and any buildings on it.
 
• It can be a valuable asset but is not considered a medium of exchange.
 
• Landed property is not universally accepted for debt repayment.
